title.zh: 三名學生跪在大會堂台階上遞請願書
title.en: Three students kneel on the Great Hall steps with a petition

summary.zh: 追悼會後，幾名學生越過警戒線，其中三人跪在大會堂東側台階上，舉著請願書，要求見國務院總理。據 Wikipedia（引 D. Zhao 2001）沒有領導人出來；UPI 當天報導則稱學生把要求清單交給一名走出來的官員。兩種說法並存，遊戲不做裁定。遊戲中主角只在遠處看見，不描寫任何真實人物的言行細節。
summary.en: After the memorial, three students knelt on the eastern steps of the Great Hall holding a petition and asking to see the Premier. Wikipedia (citing D. Zhao 2001) says no leader emerged; UPI that day reported an official took the list. The game does not adjudicate.
